
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/zhaoauau/p/20059869" title="发布于 2026-05-16 16:26">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">100条cmd命令大全</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p data-track="1">1.systeminfo:显示系统详细信息(安装日期/补丁/内存等)</p>
<p data-track="17">2.sfc/scannow:扫描并修复系统文件损坏[管理员]</p>
<p data-track="2">3.chkdsk/f:检查磁盘错误并修复(需重启)[管理员]</p>
<p data-track="3">4.cleanmgr:启动磁盘清理工具</p>
<p data-track="4">5.defrag C:/0:优化机械硬盘碎片(SSD无需使用)</p>
<p data-track="5">6.msinfo32:打开系统信息面板</p>
<p data-track="6">7.winver:显示Windows版本</p>
<p data-track="7">8.services.msc:服务管理控制台</p>
<p data-track="8">9.compmgmt.msc:计算机综合管理</p>
<p data-track="9">10.diskmgmt.msc:磁盘分区管理</p>
<p data-track="10">11.devmgmt.msc:设备管理器</p>
<p data-track="11">12.eventvwr:事件查看器</p>
<p data-track="12">13.perfmon:性能监视器</p>
<p data-track="13">14.taskschd.msc:任务计划程序</p>
<p data-track="14">15.lusrmgr.msc:本地用户和组管理</p>
<p data-track="15">16.control:打开控制面板</p>
<p data-track="16">17.appwiz.cpl:程序和功能面板</p>
<p data-track="18">18.sysdm.cpl:系统属性设置</p>
<p data-track="19">19.secpol.msc:本地安全策略</p>
<p data-track="20">20.rs0p.msc:组策略结果集</p>
<p data-track="21">31.ipconfig/all:显示完整网络配置</p>
<p data-track="22">32.ping8.8.8.8-t:持续测试网络连通性</p>
<p data-track="23">33.tracert www.baidu.com:路由追踪</p>
<p data-track="24">34.netstat-ano:查看所有网络连接</p>
<p data-track="25">35.nslookup www.qq.com:DNS解析验证</p>
<p data-track="26">36.arp-a:显示ARP缓存表</p>
<p data-track="27">37. netsh interface ip show config:显示网卡配置</p>
<p data-track="27">38.netsh interface ip set dns "以太网" static 8.8.8.8:设置静态DNS</p>
<p data-track="28">39.netshwinsockreset:重置网络协议栈</p>
<p data-track="29">40.netsh advfirewall set allprofiles state off:临时关闭防火墙</p>
<p data-track="31">41.route print:查看路由表</p>
<p data-track="32">42.net use K:\192.168.1.100\share:映射网络驱动器</p>
<p data-track="33">43. netsh wlan show profiles:查看保存的WiFi配置</p>
<p data-track="81">44. netsh wlan show profile name="Home" key=clear: 查看WiFi密码</p>
<p data-track="34">45.netsh wlan connect ssid="Office":连接指定WiFi</p>
<p data-track="82">46.pathpingwww.taobao.com:综合路由和丢包测试</p>
<p data-track="35">47.getmac/v:显示MAC地址详情</p>
<p data-track="36">48.netview:查看局域网共享资源</p>
<p data-track="37">49.netshare:管理共享文件夹</p>
<p data-track="38">50.ftp:启动FTP客户端</p>
<p data-track="39">56.dir/s/ah:递归显示目录及隐藏文件</p>
<p data-track="40">57.cd/d D:\logs:跨盘符切换目录</p>
<p data-track="41">58.robocopy C:\src D:\backup/MIR/MT:8:多线程镜像备份</p>
<p data-track="42">59.*del/F/Q.tmp:强制删除临时文件</p>
<p data-track="43">60.rd/S/Q"D:\old":无提示删除非空目录</p>
<p data-track="44">61.fsutil file createnew test.txt 1048576:生成1MB测试文件</p>
<p data-track="83">62.type filename.txt:显示文本文件内容</p>
<p data-track="45">63.copy file1.txt+file2.txt merged.txt:合并文件</p>
<p data-track="46">64.xcopy C:\data D:\backup /E/H/C:复制目录树</p>
<p data-track="84">65.move file.txt D:\newfolder:移动文件</p>
<p data-track="47">66.ren old.txt new.txt:重命名文件</p>
<p data-track="48">67.attrib+h secret.txt:设置隐藏属性</p>
<p data-track="49">68.fc file1.txt file2.txt:文件内容比较</p>
<p data-track="50">69.find"error"log.txt:文件中搜索字符串</p>
<p data-track="51">70.tree/F:显示目录树结构</p>
<p data-track="52">71.md newfolder:创建新目录</p>
<p data-track="53">72.cipher/W:D::彻底擦除磁盘剩余空间</p>
<p data-track="54">73.compact/c/s:启用NTFS压缩</p>
<p data-track="55">74.diskpart:启动磁盘分区工具</p>
<p data-track="56">75.formatE:/FS:NTFS/Q:快速格式化磁盘</p>
<p data-track="57">76.tasklist/svc:查看进程及关联服务</p>
<p data-track="58">77.taskkill/F/IMchrome.exe:强制结束进程</p>
<p data-track="59">78.taskkill/PID1234/T:结束进程树</p>
<p data-track="60">79.startnotepad:启动应用程序</p>
<p data-track="61">80. net user Tech P@sswOrd /add:创建用户</p>
<p class="syl-line-pure-english" data-track="62">81. net localgroup administrators Tech /add</p>
<p data-track="63">83.query session:查看远程桌面会话</p>
<p data-track="64">84.whoami:显示当前用户</p>
<p data-track="65">85.runas /user:admin cmd:以其他用户身份运行</p>
<p data-track="85">86.qwinsta:显示终端服务会话(同query session)</p>
<p data-track="66">87.sc query:查看服务状态</p>
<p data-track="67">88.sc stop WinDefend:停止服务</p>
<p data-track="68">89. sc config DiagTrack start= disabled:禁用服务</p>
<p data-track="86">90.wmic process get name,processid:获取进程列表</p>
<p data-track="74">91. for /L %i in (1,1,100) do ping -n 1 192.168.1.%i: 量Ping扫描</p>
<p data-track="69">92. **forfiles /p "C:\logs" /s /m *.log /d -7/c "cmd /c del@path"**:自动清理日志</p>
<p data-track="70">93. auditpol /set /category:"Account Logon"/success:enable:启用登录审核</p>
<p data-track="71">94. wmic product get name,version&gt; software.csv: 导出软件清单</p>
<p data-track="72">95. wmic memorychip get capacity,speed: 获取内存信息</p>
<p data-track="73">96. wmic diskdrive get model,size:获取硬盘信息</p>
<p data-track="75">97. reg query"HKLM\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run":查看启动项</p>
<p data-track="78">98.schtasks/query/fo LIST/v:查看计划任务详情</p>
<p data-track="79">99.vssadminlist shadows:查看卷影副本</p>
<p data-track="80">100.powercfg/batteryreport:生成电池健康报告</p>

</div>
